This is a scratch playground. I'll build a self-contained single-file HTML game "Vegas Drive" — open-world 3D driving game using Three.js from CDN. Features:

- Las Vegas Strip: boulevard with casino hotels (procedurally styled buildings: pyramid like Luxor, sphere like Sphere, towers, Eiffel tower replica, ferris wheel like High Roller), neon signs, palm trees, desert surroundings, night sky.
- Drivable car with arcade physics (WASD/arrows, handbrake, camera follow).
- Traffic cars driving on roads, collision.
- Minimap, speedometer, missions/checkpoints maybe — collectible cash pickups? Keep scope manageable but fun.
- Day/night toggle maybe; go with night neon (classic Vegas).
- Start screen with instructions.

Single file index.html. Use three.js via CDN (importmap module, e.g. unpkg three@0.160). Risk: sandbox needs internet at runtime — that's fine, it runs in user's browser.

I'll write the game carefully. Key systems:

1. Renderer, scene, fog, night sky with stars.
2. City grid: roads on grid; blocks with buildings.
3. Strip: central north-south boulevard with casinos flanking.

Simplify design but keep it rich:
- World ~ 1000x1000. Ground desert sand. Road network: main strip along Z axis at x=0, plus cross streets. Use simple looped grid roads: vertical roads at x = -150, 0, 150, horizontal at z = -150, 0, 150 etc.
- Buildings placed in blocks between roads, avoid roads.
- Nevada casino signs: glowing box signs with emissive colors, some towers.
- The Sphere: big emissive sphere in block — cool.
- Pyramid casino with spotlight beam (Luxor beam!).
- Eiffel tower from cylinders.
- Ferris wheel rotating with cabins.
- High roller style.
- Neon strip lights along roads: emissive posts.
- Street lamps with cones of light (fake glow sprites).

Car: box-based model with wheels, brake lights that light when reversing/braking, headlights as spotlights (two spotlights can be expensive but ok with shadows off). Arcade physics: velocity, steering, drift with handbrake. Collision: simple circle vs building AABBs — store colliders array; on collision push out and reduce speed.

Traffic: AI cars follow lane paths along road lines, moving straight, loop. Simple: each traffic car has axis (x or z), lane offset, direction; moves; wraps at world edges; slight collision with player: bounce / slow.

Pickups: spinning cash icons ($ signs / glowing coins) — collect to score.

Missions: simple checkpoint glow rings giving money and streak. Keep: pickups + timer? Open world — just free roam with cash pickups and a score.

Minimap: canvas 2D drawing roads, player, pickups, buildings dots.

Speedometer UI, money counter, help overlay.

Camera: chase cam with smoothing; also press C to toggle hood/top view? Keep chase + top-down toggle.

Use InstancedMesh for buildings windows? Simpler: buildings as boxes with emissive window texture generated via canvas texture — canvas-generated facade texture looks great and cheap. Generate a few canvas textures.

Shadows: maybe one directional moonlight with shadows for the player car only, small shadow map, could be fine. Might skip shadows for perf; add cheap blob shadow (circle plane under car). I'll include directional light w/ shadow constrained to follow player, 1024 map, that's OK.

Night lighting: ambient low, hemisphere, moon dir light, neon emissive materials + bloom? UnrealBloomPass via examples modules from CDN — importmap "three/addons/". Bloom would make neon pop dramatically. Use EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass. That's the classic recipe and works via unpkg/jsdelivr importmap.

Performance: bloom at full res might be heavy; set strength modest, resolution default. OK.

Fog for depth.

Stars: Points.
